visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, flowing brown hair, wearing a white ribbed crop top and baggy light blue-grey sweatpants, walks towards a floor-to-ceiling mirror in a brightly lit gym. She holds a gold-colored smartphone in her right hand, capturing a selfie video of her reflection. Behind her, rows of black and grey cardio machines, including treadmills and ellipticals, are visible under flat, bright indoor lighting. (2) She stops in front of the mirror, resting her left hand on her hip to pose, which emphasizes her toned midriff. She looks directly at the phone screen while slightly smiling. On the right side of the frame, a large blue and yellow sign containing detailed weight training rules in Chinese and English text is attached to a pillar. (3) She adjusts her hair with her left hand while maintaining her pose and gaze toward the smartphone. The gym floor is dark purple or black, and the ceiling features industrial-style exposed black piping. In the distant background, a person in dark clothing is seen walking on a treadmill.
